comparison.objective: Turn an amplifier volume down, insert a cable, restore the prior setting, and clear the arms, versus tune and lock a damper for safe carriage stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Steadying an amplifier while rotating a knob and inserting a jack differs from recessed hex torque, captive-screw loosening, bit withdrawal, collar adjustment, and moved-socket reacquisition.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires cable insertion only at zero volume and restoration of the original knob position; the candidate requires an adjusted retained setting that produces two safe impacts within force, travel, and rebound limits.
comparison.reason: This shares knob rotation, setting retention, and safe sequencing, but its core tested ability is guarded connector insertion and restoration, not iterative physical-response commissioning.
